name: Sandettie Lightvessel
description: Crucial marking vessel for Sandettie Bank and Dover Strait NE-bound lane entrance.

name: Varne Light Buoy
topmark: Two black spheres in vertical line
description: Marks Varne Bank shoal in Dover Strait. Pass with safe clearance on either side.

name: CS3 South Cardinal Buoy
description: Central separation cardinal in Dover Strait. Pass south of this mark.

name: Bassurelle SW Cardinal Buoy
description: Marks the western extremity of Bassurelle Bank. Pass to the west.

name: Greenwich Light Buoy
description: Mid-channel landfall mark on Greenwich Meridian (0° Longitude) in English Channel.

name: South Falls North Cardinal Buoy
description: Marks northern limit of South Falls Bank. Pass to the north.

name: Horsburgh Lighthouse (Batu Puteh)
description: Eastern gateway to Singapore Strait. Marks eastern end of TSS Eastbound traffic.

name: Raffles Lighthouse (Pulau Satumu)
description: Marks southern limit of Singapore Main Strait and turning point into Singapore roadsteads.

name: Helen Mar Reef North Cardinal Buoy
description: Marks Helen Mar Reef in western Singapore Strait. Keep to the north of this mark.

name: Eastern Fairway Light Buoy
description: Marks fairway centerline for deep draft vessels entering Singapore Eastern Anchorage.

name: Western Fairway Light Buoy
description: Marks fairway centerline for vessels entering Singapore Western Anchorage and Jurong Port.

name: Punta de Tarifa Light
description: Southernmost point of continental Europe. Marks northern boundary of Gibraltar TSS.

name: Europa Point Lighthouse (Gibraltar)
colour: White tower with red horizontal band
description: Gateway beacon between Atlantic Ocean and Mediterranean Sea on the Rock of Gibraltar.

name: Great Quoin Island Light
description: Key landfall and TSS reference light in Strait of Hormuz at northern tip of Musandam.

name: Tunb Island Light Buoy
description: Marks port side of inbound navigational channel past Greater Tunb Island.

name: Perim Island High Light (Mayyun)
description: Dominant navigational light dividing Large Strait and Small Strait in Bab-el-Mandeb.

name: Southwest Pass Fairway Light Buoy
description: Mississippi River sea buoy. Entrance mark for Southwest Pass navigation into New Orleans.

name: Galveston Sea Light Buoy (GB)
description: Seaward entrance mark for Galveston Bay Entrance Channel and Houston Ship Channel.

name: Dover Approach Buoy (Foxtrot)
description: Starboard hand fairway buoy marking Western Entrance approach to Port of Dover.

name: Dover Approach Buoy (Echo)
description: Port hand fairway buoy marking Eastern Entrance channel for cross-channel ferries.

name: Mid Falls South Cardinal Buoy
description: Marks southern end of The Falls shoal bank in central Dover Strait.

name: Elbe 1 Lightvessel
colour: Red hull with ELBE 1 in white
description: Key landfall mark for vessels entering Elbe Approach and Port of Hamburg.

name: Karimon East Cardinal Buoy
topmark: Two black cones base to base
description: Marks eastern reef extension off Little Karimon at western entry to Singapore Strait TSS.

name: Selat Pauh Fairway Buoy
description: Deep water channel mark for container vessels entering Pasir Panjang Terminal.

name: Blenheim Shoal South Cardinal
description: Marks Blenheim Shoal hazard south of Sentosa Island. Pass to the south.

name: Europa Point South Cardinal Buoy
description: Marks south reef shoal off Rock of Gibraltar. Keep south when rounding Europa Point.

name: Drogden Lighthouse (The Sound)
description: Controls navigation through Drogden Channel between Denmark and Sweden (Øresund).

name: Bornholmsgat West Buoy
description: Marks western side of Bornholmsgat TSS corridor in southern Baltic Sea.

name: Uraga Channel No. 1 Sea Fort Light
description: Uraga Suido main channel beacon for ships inbound to Tokyo and Yokohama.

name: Suez Canal South Fairway Buoy
description: Main landfall and pilot boarding station for northbound Suez Canal transit convoys.

name: East Goodwin Light Buoy
colour: Black with single yellow horizontal band
topmark: Two black cones base to base
description: Marks eastern edge of Goodwin Sands in Dover Strait NE flow.

name: South Goodwin Light Buoy
description: Marks southern extremity of Goodwin Sands.

name: North Falls Light Buoy
description: Northern tip of The Falls shoal bank in Southern North Sea.

name: Vergoyer Nord Light Buoy
description: Marks northern edge of Banc du Vergoyer off French coast.

name: SW Ruytingen Light Buoy
description: Marks SW edge of Ruytingen Bank in Dunkerque approach.

name: F3 Inshore Traffic Zone Buoy
description: Delimits English Inshore Traffic Zone boundary off Dover.

name: Maas Center Safe Water Buoy
description: Approach fairway buoy for Eurogeul channel to Port of Rotterdam.

name: Wandelaar Pilot Station Buoy (A1)
description: Wandelaar pilot boarding area for Westerschelde and Antwerp ports.

name: Weser Sea Light Buoy
description: German Bight main landfall for Bremerhaven and Bremen.

name: One Fathom Bank Lighthouse
description: Guards central One Fathom Bank shoal in Malacca Strait TSS.

name: Batu Berhanti Light Beacon
shape: White round tower with yellow/black bands
description: Critical turning beacon in Singapore Strait Main Strait corridor.

name: Tanjung Piai South Light Buoy
description: Marks southern tip of Asian mainland in western Singapore approach.

name: Tarifa TSS Northern Boundary Buoy
description: Demarcates northern limit of Gibraltar TSS westbound lane.

name: Tanger Med Fairway Light Buoy
description: Entrance to Tanger Med megaport container terminals in Morocco.

name: Port Said Fairway Buoy
description: Suez Canal northbound convoy discharge / southbound convoy entry.

name: Abu Ail Islands Light (Zukur)
description: Controls navigation through Zubair / Hanish channel in southern Red Sea.

name: Ambrose Lighted Whistle Buoy (A)
shape: Large ocean disc buoy with whistle
description: Main approach waypoint for Ambrose Channel and New York / New Jersey harbor.

name: San Francisco Bar Lighted Bell Buoy (SF)
description: Main Bar Channel entrance leading to the Golden Gate.
